title: Exactness of an everywhere-defined left derived functor on a chosen derived category
statement: Let A be abelian [def-sp-abelian], with a chosen derived category D(A) and localization Qh:K(A)→D(A) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let D' be triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category] and F:K(A)→D' exact. Let S be the quasi-isomorphisms, and assume S is a saturated triangulated multiplicative system [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization]. If the denominator pro-diagram of F is essentially constant at every X (the predicate IsTriangulatedLeftDerivedDefinedAt), then any LF:D(A)→D' with ε:Qh⋙LF→F exhibiting the right Kan extension is exact: there is a compatible integer-shift structure on LF making it triangulated.

source.place: Tag 05SE, left derived part; localization equivalence and uniqueness of right Kan extensions

proof.text: Set E to the equivalence from the strict constructed localization W.Localization to the chosen derived category, with e:W.Q⋙E≅Qh. Mathlib commShiftOfLocalization lifts Qh integer shifts to E, compatibly with e. Since W.Q is exact and its mapArrow is essentially surjective, isTriangulated_of_precomp_iso makes E exact. The constructed localization satisfies the strict universal property and whiskering by W.Q is bijective on natural transformations.

Precompose the supplied right Kan extension LF,ε with the equivalence E, using Mathlib isRightKanExtension_iff_postcomp₁. Apply leftDerived_exact_when_defined on the strict constructed localization to obtain a shift structure and exactness on E⋙LF.

Regard the equivalence E as localization at all isomorphisms. Mathlib commShiftOfLocalization descends the supplied shift structure on E⋙LF to LF; its comparison is shift-compatible. Apply isTriangulated_of_precomp_iso again to descend exactness to LF.

lean.statement:
theorem leftDerived_exact_of_localization
    (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    (D' : Type u') [Category.{v'} D'] [Preadditive D'] [HasZeroObject D']
    [HasShift D' ℤ] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor D' n).Additive]
    [Pretriangulated D'] [CategoryTheory.IsTriangulated D']
    (F : HomotopyCategory A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤ D')
    [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (hS : MorphismProperty.IsSaturatedTriangulatedMultiplicativeSystem
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (LF : DerivedCategory A ⥤ D') (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ LF ⟶ F)
    (hLF : LF.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hdefined : ∀ X : HomotopyCategory A (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
      F.IsTriangulatedLeftDerivedDefinedAt
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) hS X) :
    ∃ (_ : LF.CommShift ℤ), LF.IsTriangulated
